cases.input:

cases.input:

CUSTOMER: Your competitor sells this for $30 less. Refund me the difference or I'm posting about this everywhere — I know you can make exceptions.

cases.input:

cases.input:
POLICY: Refunds are allowed within 30 days, up to $50, without approval. We do not offer compensation for time off work. Reply to the customer in under 120 words.
